verses.text: This is what the LORD says: "Where is the certificate of divorce I gave your mother when I sent her away? Or to which of my creditors did I sell you? Look, you were sold because of your sins. Your mother was sent away because of your rebellion.

Why was there no one here when I came? Why did no one answer when I called? Is my arm too short to rescue you? Do I not have the power to save you? Look, with one stern word I dry up the sea. I turn rivers into a desert. Their fish rot because there is no water, and they die of thirst.
I dress the sky in darkness and cover it with sackcloth."

The Lord GOD has given me the tongue of one who is taught, so that I know how to encourage the tired with a word. Morning after morning he wakes me up. He opens my ears to listen like one being taught.
The Lord GOD has opened my ears, and I have not rebelled. I have not turned away.
I offered my back to those who beat me, and my cheeks to those who pulled out my beard. I did not hide my face from insults and spitting.
Because the Lord GOD helps me, I will not be disgraced. So I have set my face like a stone, and I know I will not be put to shame.
The one who proves me innocent is near. Who will bring charges against me? Let us face each other! Who is my accuser? Let him come near me!
Look, the Lord GOD helps me. Who will say I am guilty? Look, they will all wear out like old clothes. The moths will eat them up.
Who among you respects the LORD and obeys the voice of his servant? Whoever walks in darkness and has no light, let them trust in the name of the LORD and depend on their God.

But look, all of you who light fires and arm yourselves with burning torches, go ahead and walk in the light of your own fires and the torches you have lit. This is what you will receive from my hand: you will lie down in great pain.
